message.content:
For a reflection matrix \(R\) through a plane with unit normal vector \(\mathbf n\), the normal vector satisfies

\[
R\mathbf n = -\mathbf n.
\]

The given matrix is

\[
R=\frac1{15}
\begin{pmatrix}
11&2&10\\
2&14&-5\\
10&-5&-10
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

So we solve

\[
\frac1{15}
\begin{pmatrix}
11&2&10\\
2&14&-5\\
10&-5&-10
\end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix}x\\y\\z\end{pmatrix}
=
-\begin{pmatrix}x\\y\\z\end{pmatrix}.
\]

Multiplying by \(15\),

\[
\begin{pmatrix}
11&2&10\\
2&14&-5\\
10&-5&-10
\end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix}x\\y\\z\end{pmatrix}
=
-15\begin{pmatrix}x\\y\\z\end{pmatrix}.
\]

Thus,

\[
\begin{pmatrix}
26&2&10\\
2&29&-5\\
10&-5&5
\end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix}x\\y\\z\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}0\\0\\0\end{pmatrix}.
\]

Solving gives a normal vector

\[
\begin{pmatrix}2\\-1\\-5\end{pmatrix}.
\]

This has \(a=2>0\) and \(\gcd(2,1,5)=1\).

The answer is \(\begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ -1 \\ -5 \end{pmatrix}\).
